contradictions.source: בית הלל אומרים מטבילין כלי שהוא מלא משקין והטבילו כאילו לא טבל
contradictions.english: The House of Hillel says: one may immerse a vessel that is full of liquid, and if one immersed it [in a pool], it is as if it were not immersed.
contradictions.why: The English adds 'if one immersed it... it is as if it were not immersed', which contradicts the House of Hillel's position that it IS validly immersed.
